gaps: The Ladakh order of August 2021 that dropped the permit for Indian citizens was not found; only news reports of it.
No official page states the Ladakh tourist fee amounts, so they are left out.
No government order found for the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh; the result of the central ministry ruling awaited in May 2023 is unknown.
Rohtang permit fees, daily quota and any two-wheeler rule are not on the official portal or its question-and-answer document.
No official statement found that the Atal Tunnel needs no permit.
Whether the e-Aagman vehicle pass is enforced on motorcycles was not confirmed.
Whether motorcycles pay under the Himachal Pradesh entry toll policy of 1 April 2026 was not verified; the policy itself comes from a search result only.
Date motorcycles were first allowed in 2023 not found.
Winter closure date for 2021 not found as an order; only the date of the last convoy.
Sources disagree on the 2025 connection date (12 or 13 May) and the 2023 one (25 or 26 March).
2026 winter closure had not happened by 28 September 2026.
Usual days is taken from an encyclopedia line that the trip normally needs one overnight halt; riders often take longer.
Whether motorcycles need an extra undertaking from the Manali magistrate's office for Rohtang appears in search results only and was not confirmed.
Video filming dates are not stated on the pages; they were published on 16 June 2025 and 3 March 2026.
